summary:
Implemented the Tabs widget per the spec, but nothing was executed (repo rules forbade running code), so all verification was by reading only; the new and updated tests have not been run.

Changed/added files:
- src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (new): Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs; __all__ = ["Tab", "Tabs"].
- src/textual/renderables/underline_bar.py: yields one Text; new clickable_ranges input before width; click spans appended last; early path adds no click metadata. Existing output unchanged by construction.
- src/textual/renderables/opacity.py: blended color merged into existing segment style, preserving meta and other attributes.
- tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and tests/renderables/test_opacity.py: new tests appended; existing tests untouched.
- tests/test_tabs.py (new): construction, empty-list row, duplicate names, flexible padding (24/25 shares computed from the layout rule), dimmed padded cells with click metadata, underline half-cell glyphs and styles, navigation, number and first-character activation, initial state.
- docs/reference/tabs.md (new): single ::: directive for textual.widgets.tabs.Tabs.
- sandbox/tabs_demo.py and sandbox/tabs_demo.css (new): mounts Tabs directly on the App; stylesheet uses only margin.

Decisions: layout_resolve needed no change (Edge already has size, min_size=1, fraction=1). Inactive dimming uses Opacity per span with a separate meta-only click span. Letter search only applies to single-character keys.

Known limitations:
1. Duplicate names: find_tab_by_name returns a full-list index while the bar indexes displayed tabs, so with [A, A, B] and B active the bar targets index 2 and wraps to A. Followed the spec literally; needs a decision to fix.
2. Wide characters: label spans and click ranges are cell-based but Text spans are character-based, so double-width labels misalign.
3. A zero-width label is treated as a flexible edge and renders one cell wide.

No commits made. Not run: pytest, any Python, or the sandbox demo.
